newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda to export new Prelude coupe.
newsitem.headline: Honda to export new Prelude coupe.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd will export its remodelled Prelude two-door specialty coupe at a monthly rate of 2,500 units, a Honda spokesman said on Thursday.
Of the total, 1,500 will go to the North American market for sales starting in mid-January and the rest will go mainly to Europe for marketing from end-December.
Honda also said on Thursday that this model would go on sale in Japan on November 8, and that it set a monthly sales target of 1,500 units.
The new Prelude will compete with Toyota Motor's Celica and Nissan Motor's Silvia.
The domestic price will start at 1.68 million yen, some 300,000 to 400,000 yen cheaper than that of its predecessor, the spokesman said.
Japan's market for two-door specialty coupes stands at about 114,000 units a year.
The new Prelude features a semi-automatic transmission.
